National Geographic Explorer and photographer Abdullah Dhiaa Al-Deen has always been drawn to palm trees, which are deeply woven into the landscape of his native country of Iraq. But palm trees across the country are in decline due to climate change, water scarcity, and rapid urban expansion. In this image, Al-Deen wanted to "create a quiet, poetic visual dialogue between the fragile, earthbound heritage of the palms and the celestial sky above," he says.
